scope: Snapshot-bound read-only mapping/mount probe and local Android Runtime APEX inventory
script_actions: Verify root, early-debug flag, slot B, super label/device/capacity, read-only userdata and exact live metadata hash
Inspect actual APEX contents and linker target availability
Temporarily bind dev/proc/sys into Sailfish chroot for native dmsetup
Create four n100_ro_ mappings with --readonly; require sysfs ro=1
Mount ext4 ro,noload at unique RAM scratch paths and inspect stock properties/APEX directory listings
Attempt removal of own scratch mounts, mappings and bind mounts on exit; report any cleanup failure
